title: Missing validation of CONNECT requests in http2
description: A vulnerability in the http2 library up to version 5.4.13 allows malformed CONNECT requests to bypass validation checks. Specifically, the library failed to enforce the presence of the :authority header and the consistency between :authority and Host headers, enabling request smuggling past front-end access controls when front-end and backend use different headers for routing or authorization. This was fixed in http2 version 5.4.14, which properly validates CONNECT requests and rejects malformed ones with a PROTOCOL_ERROR stream error.
